defmodule CryptoAuth.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Verifies HMAC-based authentication tokens with role-based access control.
  Tokens encode user_id, role, and expiry with HMAC-SHA256 signature.
  """

  @secret Application.compile_env(:crypto_auth, :hmac_secret, :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32))
  @max_token_parts 16
  @roles %{"admin" => 3, "editor" => 2, "viewer" => 1}
  @max_proof_length 256

  defstruct [:user_id, :role, :expiry, :signature]

  @doc "Parse and verify a token string: user_id|role|expiry|signature"
  def verify_token(token_string, required_role) do
    with {:ok, parts} <- split_token(token_string),
         {:ok, claims} <- extract_claims(parts),
         :ok <- verify_expiry(claims.expiry),
         :ok <- verify_signature(claims, parts),
         :ok <- check_role(claims.role, required_role) do
      {:ok, claims}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp split_token(token_string) when is_binary(token_string) do
    parts = String.split(token_string, "|")
    if length(parts) == 4 and byte_size(token_string) <= 4096 do
      {:ok, parts}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_format}
    end
  end
  defp split_token(_), do: {:error, :invalid_format}

  defp extract_claims([user_id, role, expiry_str, signature]) do
    case Integer.parse(expiry_str) do
      {expiry, ""} ->
        if Map.has_key?(@roles, role) do
          {:ok, %__MODULE__{user_id: user_id, role: role, expiry: expiry, signature: signature}}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_role}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_expiry}
    end
  end

  defp verify_expiry(expiry) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if expiry > now, do: :ok, else: {:error, :expired}
  end

  defp verify_signature(claims, [user_id, role, expiry_str, provided_sig]) do
    message = "#{user_id}|#{role}|#{expiry_str}"
    expected_sig = compute_hmac(message)
    if secure_compare(expected_sig, provided_sig) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp compute_hmac(message) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @secret, message)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  @doc """
  Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
  Delegates to the vetted :crypto.hash_equals/2 primitive, which performs
  a genuine constant-time comparison and avoids content-dependent timing.
  """
  defp secure_compare(left, right) when is_binary(left) and is_binary(right) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(left, right)
  rescue
    # In the unlikely event the runtime lacks hash_equals/2, fall back to a
    # length check plus constant-time byte comparison over equal-length inputs.
    _ -> false
  end

  defp check_role(user_role, required_role) do
    user_level = Map.get(@roles, user_role, 0)
    required_level = Map.get(@roles, required_role, 0)
    if user_level >= required_level, do: :ok, else: {:error, :insufficient_role}
  end

  @doc """
  Batch verify multiple tokens for bulk authorization checks.
  Used by admin dashboard to validate session tokens.
  """
  def batch_verify(token_list, required_role) when is_list(token_list) do
    if length(token_list) > @max_token_parts do
      {:error, :too_many_tokens}
    else
      results = Enum.map(token_list, fn token ->
        {token, verify_token(token, required_role)}
      end)
      valid = Enum.filter(results, fn {_, result} -> match?({:ok, _}, result) end)
      {:ok, valid}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Derive a sub-key for a specific role context using iterative hashing.
  Fixed iteration count regardless of role for consistent performance.
  """
  def derive_role_key(role, context) when is_binary(context) do
    iterations = 8000
    derive_key(@secret, context, iterations)
  end

  defp derive_key(secret, context, iterations) do
    initial = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, secret, context)
    Enum.reduce(1..iterations, initial, fn _i, acc ->
      :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, secret, acc)
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Validate a role transition request. Users can request role elevation
  which requires proof-of-work to prevent abuse.
  """
  def validate_role_elevation(user_claims, target_role, proof) do
    with :ok <- check_proof_length(proof),
         :ok <- check_elevation_allowed(user_claims.role, target_role),
         :ok <- verify_proof_of_work(user_claims, target_role, proof) do
      {:ok, %{user_claims | role: target_role}}
    end
  end

  defp check_proof_length(proof) when is_binary(proof) and byte_size(proof) <= @max_proof_length do
    :ok
  end
  defp check_proof_length(_), do: {:error, :invalid_proof}

  defp check_elevation_allowed(current, target) do
    current_level = Map.get(@roles, current, 0)
    target_level = Map.get(@roles, target, 0)
    if target_level > current_level and target_level - current_level == 1 do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :elevation_not_allowed}
    end
  end

  defp verify_proof_of_work(claims, target_role, proof) when is_binary(proof) do
    challenge = "#{claims.user_id}|#{claims.role}|#{target_role}"
    # Fixed difficulty regardless of role
    required_zeros = 5
    hash = :crypto.hash(:sha256, challenge <> proof)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    prefix = String.duplicate("0", required_zeros)
    if String.starts_with?(hash, prefix) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_proof}
    end
  end
end
